description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called SkillsSettings, which is part of a macOS application. It manages displaying, filtering, and interacting with a list of skills, including features to refresh data, show skill details, enable/disable skills, install skills, and edit environment variables. It also contains a ViewModel class for handling data fetching and state management related to skills.

classes.name: SkillsSettingsModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class annotated with @Observable for managing the state of skills, including fetching skills status, enabling/disabling skills, installing skills, and updating environment variables.

classes.name: EnvEditorState
classes.description: A struct representing the state for editing environment variables associated with a skill.

classes.name: SkillRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that displays detailed information and actions for a single skill, including status, enable/disable toggle, installation options, and missing requirements.

classes.name: SkillsFilter
classes.description: An enum for filtering skills within the UI by status: all, ready, needs setup, or disabled.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and updates the list of skill statuses.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initiates the installation process for a specific skill to a target (local or remote).

methods.name: updateEnv
methods.description: Updates environment variables or API key for a skill.

methods.name: isBusy
methods.description: Checks if a specific skill is currently busy (performing an operation).
